channel.title: Inspired Scripture Reflections
channel.description: Weekly reflections from Inspired Scripture: short readings that open up each new Bible study of the Old Testament.

item.title: Living Your Life With Jesus' Wisdom
item.description: A little folly ruins a lifetime of wisdom. Seven marks of a life lived by Jesus' wisdom, drawn from the proverbs of Ecclesiastes 10.

item.title: Finding Meaning in a Short Life
item.description: Seven lessons from Ecclesiastes 9 for finding meaning in a life you cannot lengthen, from faith and hope to serving and trusting Jesus.

item.title: The Futility of Trusting in Wealth
item.description: Solomon had more wealth than anyone alive and still called it vapor. Seven warnings from Ecclesiastes 6 for anyone tempted to hope in what they own.
